name: validation_accuracy_first
decision_basis: Frozen training/validation audit found substantive selection loss in scales_s1 and both shared_parameter seeds.
Known shared nonlinear structure recovered a=1.7 with the original single start and five function evaluations on both seeds.
Instrumented original searches matched both archived fingerprints; the best validation candidates remained in the final pool.
effect: Keep validation constraint violation first; within the best violation tier minimize mean validation NRMSE, then use complexity to break exact ties.
unchanged: Training generation, neural updates, GP, NSGA-II, shared representation, fitting budget, candidate freeze, domain screening, per-output constraints and all default settings.
scope: Experimental configuration using an existing public control. No production source change is needed.
hypothesis: Removing the final additive complexity penalty recovers candidate accuracy on new development splits without unacceptable per-output or complexity regression.
known_risk: Near-zero numerical differences may prefer unnecessarily complex candidates. Report complexity and apply the predeclared recommendation gate.
